products.title: Men's Trail Blazer

description.plain:
The Trail Blazer is here – the ultimate trail and hiking shoe designed for those who crave both performance and comfort on rugged terrain. This wider version of the Trailhead offers a secure, roomy fit, making it the perfect choice for those who need extra space without compromising support. It features the Trail Traction Outsole, seen on the Primal Pursuit, with a full rubber outsole and aggressive lugs that provide superior traction, cushion, and grip for a stable, comfortable experience on any trail. With its zero drop design, the Trail Blazer promotes natural alignment and a closer connection to the ground. The shoe also boasts a breathable air mesh upper combined with microfiber, wicking away moisture to keep your feet cool and dry. Available in four stylish colorways, the Trail Blazer seamlessly blends performance with versatility.

Lightweight yet durable, the Trail Blazer is built for adventurers who value comfort, breathability, and reliable performance. Whether you're conquering challenging hikes or going for your daily run, these shoes will keep you moving with ease and confidence. Ready for your next outdoor adventure? So are we.

Please note, Safari is not vegan due to the leather rand.

Features
  • Fit: Lems WIDE Natural-Shape™
  • Upper: Microfiber & Air Mesh
  • Lining: Polyester
  • Midsole: EVA
  • Outsole: Full rubber Trail Traction Outsole with 3mm lugs
  • Insole: Minimal Poly Insole
  • Stack Height: 14mm
  • Drop: Zero-Drop
  • Weight: 10.8oz (Men's 10) 
  • Non-Vegan: Safari

For additional information please check out our FAQ page!

We find that the Trail Blazer fits true to size, so you can order your normal US size.

As with all Lems shoes, if you need more volume inside the shoe or increased ground contact, you can remove the insole. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our customer service team at support@lemsshoes.com.

description.plain:
Brooks Cascadia 17 — Men's

The Brooks Cascadia has been the benchmark for trail running footwear for years — and the Cascadia 17 continues that legacy with meaningful updates that make it faster, more stable, and more capable than ever. Built for runners who take on serious mountain terrain, the Cascadia 17 delivers the trifecta of trail performance: soft cushioning that responds to the trail, a protective plate that adapts to varied terrain, and aggressive traction that handles whatever the mountain throws at you. Mile after mountainous mile, this is the shoe that keeps you moving.

What's New in the Cascadia 17

  • Enhanced All-Terrain Stability: Updated geometry and construction for a more confident, controlled ride on technical terrain.
  • Improved Traction: New TrailTack® Green Rubber outsole with 25% recycled content — engineered for slippery ground, rocky crags, and everything in between.
  • Lightweight Cushioning: DNA LOFT v2 midsole delivers a softer, more responsive ride without adding weight.

Shoe Technology

  • DNA LOFT v2 Midsole: Soft, lightweight cushioning that reacts to your unique stride and the trail surface beneath you — super soft, but never too squishy. Midsole Drop: 8mm.
  • Protective Plate: Internal plate that shields your foot from sharp rocks and roots while helping the shoe adapt to varied terrain underfoot.
  • Strategically Placed Outsole Pods: Designed to respond to uneven ground for a stable, sure-footed ride on technical trails.
  • TrailTack® Green Rubber Outsole: Made with 25% recycled content. Aggressive lug pattern provides maximum traction on wet, muddy, and rocky surfaces.
  • Weight: 11.0 oz / 311.8g

Who It's For

The Cascadia 17 is built for trail runners who demand performance on serious mountain terrain — from technical singletrack to rocky ridgelines. If you want a trail shoe with a proven legacy, meaningful updates, and the traction to handle any surface, the Cascadia 17 is your shoe.
